name: FBXL5
evidence_proves_hypothesis: TDP-43 depletion induces coordinated distal 3'UTR lengthening of BOTH FBXL5 (chr4:15604539:-, dPAS=+0.0873, padj=4.45e-4) and its direct substrate IREB2/IRP2 (chr15:78501450:+, dPAS=+0.1279, padj=3.02e-24) alongside FTH1 (dPAS=+0.0785, S4 padj=5.31e-45) and ACO1 (dPAS=+0.0948, padj=0.00883) plus TFRC/FTL KD mRNA upregulation; postmortem tissues show GC-adjusted NYGC FBXL5 RNA elevation (GC=37.97%: Motor n=205 adj_beta=+0.1758, p=3.38e-5; Frontal n=257 +0.1342, p=3.22e-5; Spinal n=262 +0.1990, p=8.03e-4), Spillman MOESM1 cortical DIA proteomics iron-axis remodeling (Synaptosome TFRC log2FC=-1.2067, p=7.08e-4, padj=0.109; Homogenate IREB2 -0.6213, p=0.0259; Homogenate ACO1 +0.4150, p=0.0071), and elevated CSF ceruloplasmin (DIA p=0.0273). Structures 3V5Z and 6VCD prove FBXL5 requires [Fe-O-Fe] and [2Fe-2S] cofactors to engage IRP2 (37 contacts <=4.0A).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Two major risks lower scientific taste despite valid Epistemic Asymmetry retention: (1) Cell-type split & compensatory glial risk: single-nucleus pseudobulks show FBXL5 mRNA is completely flat in human sALS excitatory neurons (Pineda BA9_Exc p=0.628, BA4_Exc p=0.208; Edinburgh Exc p=0.179) while upregulated in microglia (Edinburgh donor-collapsed n=33 diff=+0.459, p=0.00334; 48-library +0.474) and astrocytes (BA4_Astro +0.246, p=0.0316) alongside FTH1/FTL ferritin co-induction, consistent with reactive glial iron-buffering secondary to motor-neuron death, and FBXL5 protein itself is UNDETECTED in Spillman MOESM1 cortical & MOESM3 iPSC DIA proteomics; (2) Indiscriminate iron chelation (Deferiprone 2.5 uM, ~13 uM free-brain exposure) failed in 16 sALS iPSC-MN lines in Bye 2025 (raw mean=+0.115d, med=-0.274d, t=0.41, p=0.686; paired vs DMSO +0.243d, p=0.375, Wilcoxon p=0.860, 9/16 worsened; -3.72d vs Riluzole p=9.2e-9) and worsened PD/AD in FAIRPARK-II/FAIR-AD because stripping iron destabilizes holo-FBXL5, while FBXL5 (KO E8.5 lethal, 5D=75/100) and IREB2 (OMIM 618451 neurodegeneration, 5D=78/100) impose a narrow bidirectional safety window.
factual_justification: Under Epistemic Asymmetry, Deferiprone's failure falsifies bulk iron chelation (which strips Fe2+/[2Fe-2S] out of FBXL5) rather than holo-FBXL5 modulation, and FBXL5 protein abundance in human ALS motor neurons has never been measured; however, taste is downgraded to LOW_TO_MODERATE_COMPENSATORY_GLIAL_RISK because postmortem FBXL5 mRNA elevation is glial rather than neuronal.
discriminating_next_test: Cell-type-resolved test in human iPSC-MN + iron-loaded microglia co-cultures evaluating selective cytosolic IRP2 modulation (sparing PDB 6VCD Cys662/676/686/687 [2Fe-2S] holo-FBXL5 and glial ferritin sequestration, with Deferiprone 2.5 uM as negative control), explicitly gating against CNS PROTAC BBB exclusion and wrong-sign exacerbation of already-depleted ALS neuronal IREB2/TFRC (OMIM 618451).

name: CHIT1 / GPNMB / CHI3L1-CHI3L2 microglial chitinase-lysosomal staging axis
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: VERIFIED_QUANTITATIVELY: Re-computation in Trautwig 4-center CSF DIA (total N=259: Emory 118, MGH 78, WashU 32, UMilan 31; sALS n=50 vs Ctrl n=72) & Emory TMT (N=101) and Oh 2023 confirms symptomatic-only elevation across all 4 purple-module proteins (CHIT1 q=3.24e-09, BatchOLS +1.7955, p=2.51e-08; CHI3L2 q=2.29e-09; CHI3L1 q=8.04e-04; GPNMB q=0.00162, BatchOLS +0.3328, p=0.00480), with complete absence in pre-symptomatic C9orf72/SOD1 carriers (p=0.2937-0.9918). prior_art_crowding_level: VERY_HIGH_BIOMARKER_BENCHMARK (established CSF chitinase/GPNMB ALS staging & PIKfyve PD biomarker panel; OATD-01 tested only in pulmonary sarcoidosis NCT06205121)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Air-tight replication across Trautwig TMT/DIA, Oh 2023 CSF, NYGC spinal cord, Edinburgh snRNA-seq, and Zhang TDP-43+ spatial niches establishes the 4-protein panel as a premier cross-sectional symptomatic-vs-asymptomatic staging, ALS-Glia stratification, and lysosomal target-engagement biomarker suite.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Natural human CHIT1 null homozygosity (rs3831317) fails to confer ALS protection or survival benefit, GPNMB loss/inhibition exacerbates motor-neuron stress (wrong sign for inhibition), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 lack catalytic activity.
factual_justification: All four sub-nodes (C017-N1..N4) replicate strongly as symptomatic cross-sectional symptomatic-vs-asymptomatic staging and glial/lysosomal fluid biomarkers (completely flat in pre-symptomatic C9/SOD1 carriers), but fail Track B drug-target criteria: human genetic CHIT1 deficiency (rs3831317) does not alter ALS risk/progression, GPNMB is compensatory/neuroprotective (wrong sign for inhibition), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 are catalytically inactive pseudochitinases.
discriminating_next_test: Deploy rs3831317-genotype-adjusted CSF CHIT1 + GPNMB + CHI3L1/CHI3L2 as a quantitative cross-sectional symptomatic-vs-asymptomatic staging and ALS-Glia / lysosomal pharmacodynamic biomarker panel in Track A/B trials rather than pursuing chitinase/GPNMB inhibition.

(Cell 2024, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058) establishes C3-independent neuronal C1q uptake into RNP complexes/polysomes.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Phase 2 MERIDIAN (NCT04579666, SC pegcetacoplan C3, N=249) terminated for Week 52 CAFS & secondary futility alongside C5 failures; bulk cord RNA and CSF shifts largely reflect microglial proportion/center confounding; systemic C1Q ablation carries >90% SLE/encapsulated-sepsis liability (61.1-72.2/100); and C1qa KO in SOD1 mice exacerbated motor-neuron C-bouton loss (Lobsiger et al., PNAS 2013, PMID:24145411).
factual_justification: Sub-node dissection drops C3 (C018-N4, FALSIFIED_CLINICAL in Phase 2 MERIDIAN) and C4B (C018-N5, ARTIFACT_CONFOUNDED). Per Epistemic Asymmetry, CNS parenchymal C1q (C018-N1..N3) was NOT falsified by MERIDIAN for two independent reasons: (a) SC pegcetacoplan (~43.5 kDa, <0.1% intact-BBB entry, Liver C3=1575.28 TPM sink) could not test spinal anterior-horn parenchyma, and (b) neuronal C1q endocytosis and RNA-dependent LLPS into RNP/polysome complexes plus LRP1/CALR signaling act independently of C3 cleavage (Scott-Hewitt et al., Cell 2024, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058). However, systemic IV ANX005 (~150 kDa IgG4, <0.3% CSF entry + >90% SLE/sepsis systemic liability) is rejected while systemic IV BBB-TfR-shuttled IgG depletes 99.99% of 180 nM serum C1q and unmodified q4w IT 48 kDa Fab washes out via CSF bulk turnover (EV-P2-T4-002), requiring ECM-anchored HLE IT Fab/nanobody, continuous IT pump, or IT microglial C1QA/B ASO/di-siRNA.
discriminating_next_test: Reject C3, C4B, chronic IV ANX005 (10.7% SLE/hemolysis/pneumonitis withdrawals in HD NCT04514367, PMID:41787606), systemic IV BBB-TfR-shuttled IgG (99.99% serum C1q depletion against 180 nM serum C1q), AND unmodified q4w IT 48 kDa Fab (cleared by ~4x/day CSF bulk flow, t1/2 ~12h -> <0.001 nM trough). Test ECM-anchored half-life-extended IT anti-C1q Fab/nanobody, continuous IT pump infusion, or IT microglial C1QA/B 2'-O-MOE ASO/di-siRNA (>99.7% cord block, >99.6% serum spared) with mandatory Lobsiger 2013 (PMID:24145411) cholinergic C-bouton (SLC18A3/SLC5A7) and Scott-Hewitt 2024 neuronal RNP proteostasis gates.

name: Baricitinib
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rank #2/107 in Bye 2025 pure sALS iPSC-MNs (+3.774d, 14/16 lines, p=2.56e-7, q=6.85e-6); TDP-43 KD induces neuronal JAK2 3'UTR shortening (dPAS=-0.4391, padj=2.96e-61) & AAK1 lengthening (dPAS=+0.1673, padj=6.32e-16) replicated by Edinburgh excitatory JAK2 upregulation (+0.4907, p=0.0457, n=34); NYGC ALS-Glia enriches gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 (cortex z_diff=+0.7031, p=6.27e-4, AUC=0.7893; cord z_diff=+0.4169, p=1.91e-6, AUC=0.7186; cord JAK1/2 vs Ctrl p<3e-7); NADALS (NCT05189106, n=8-9 ALS) proves 3.80 nM CSF entry at 4 mg/d with -38.1% longitudinal CSF CXCL10 reduction and stable CSF NfL (5523->5796->5504 pg/mL).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: P-gp/BCRP efflux limits Kp,uu,CSF to ~0.05-0.11 (3.80 nM CSF = 0.095x whole-cell pSTAT IC50 ~40 nM [~8.7% cellular occupancy]; 657x below 2.5 uM screen); NADALS ALS had 1/9 PE SAE + 1/9 DVT event (1-2/9 [11.1-22.2%] ALS participants; un-deduplicated in NCT05189106 aggregate AE table); structural/mechanistic JAK1-vs-neuronal-JAK2 catch-22 where JAK2-sparing selective JAK1 JH1 inhibitors forfeit TDP-43-induced autonomous neuronal JAK2 survival rescue (if 2.5 uM Bye rescue requires neuronal JAK2 or saturating AAK1/kinome polypharmacology) whereas retaining JAK2 hits EPO/TPO and JAK1/2 VTE walls; allosteric TYK2-JH2 spares gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 (cord TypeI-IFN/TYK2 axis p=0.843, AUC=0.508) and neuronal JAK2; shotgun MS CSF CXCL10 suffers left-censored MNAR/tryptic scarcity (31.3% DIA / 84.2% TMT missing), is Emory-matched center-null (symp_als p=0.838, sALS p=0.602), and is orthogonal (DIA r=+0.0517, TMT r=-0.366) to the 4-protein Glial Bridge; gnomAD v4 oeUpper JAK1=0.178, JAK2=0.739 + FDA Boxed Warnings bar unstratified chronic dosing.
factual_justification: Human ALS CSF CXCL10 target engagement (-38.1% at 4 mg/d) and neuronal TDP-43 JAK2 3'UTR APA + pure-MN survival rescue alongside gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 ALS-Glia enrichment forbid DROP under Epistemic Asymmetry, but C019 is recalibrated to the Tier 3 exploratory watchlist because 3.80 nM CSF (~8.7% cellular pSTAT occupancy) is 657x below the 2.5 uM screen, NADALS recorded 1/9 PE SAE + 1/9 DVT event across N=9 ALS participants (un-deduplicated in aggregate registry), and JAK2-sparing selective JAK1 inhibition creates a mechanistic catch-22 by forfeiting cell-autonomous neuronal JAK2 coverage.
discriminating_next_test: Resolve the JAK1-vs-neuronal-JAK2 catch-22 at clinically reachable unbound human CSF concentrations (3.8-50 nM; ~8.7% whole-cell pSTAT occupancy at 3.8 nM vs 39-40% cell-free JAK1/2) by testing Baricitinib vs Kp,uu-verified homodimeric-JAK2 (EPO/TPO)-sparing selective JAK1 JH1 inhibitors and CRISPRi JAK1/JAK2/AAK1 knockdowns across BOTH glia-free sALS iPSC-MNs (testing whether 2.5 uM rescue vanishes at 4-50 nM or upon JAK2 sparing) and reactive ALS-Glia co-cultures — barring co-dosing with S07 ld-IL-2 and mandating VTE thromboprophylaxis — before any CSF Glial Bridge-stratified (rs3831317-neutral sALS-p80) interaction trial.

name: Apilimod
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rescues mean Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MN survival at 2.5 uM (+1.837d, 12/16 lines, p=0.00210, q=0.0173); AIT-101 125 mg BID in C9orf72-ALS (NCT05163886, N=15) reached 3.89 nM CSF (Kp,uu~0.72), cutting 12-wk randomized CSF poly(GP) by 74.4% with CSF NfL -5.0% (6,706.8->6,372.7 pg/mL vs +9.1% pbo) and 0 drug-related SAEs.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: D045 CSF GDI2 is null in sALS vs Ctrl (TMT diff_log2=+0.0245, p=0.208; DIA +0.0200, p=0.504; C9 only p=0.00598/0.0268); 4/16 (25%, 0 ties) sALS lines worsened; NCT05163886 CSF sGPNMB was unchanged (p=0.352) while Wk12 Plasma NfL rose +39.2% & Wk24 OLE CSF NfL rose +49.7% (n=4/10), and VRG50635 caused 2/6 (33%) encephalopathy/renal SAEs in Ph1 (NCT06286475, PMC12916242) plus astrocytic GFAP+NfL co-elevation & 8/54 (14.8%) drug SAEs in ALS (NCT06215755; PIKFYVE oeUpper=0.550, MGI brain vacuoles), refuting naive benign NfL exosome-flushing for continuous dosing.
factual_justification: 12-wk randomized C9orf72-ALS target engagement (-74.4% CSF poly(GP), -5.0% CSF NfL, N=15 unpowered) and untested sALS status forbid DROP, but continuous PIKfyve blockade hits a human vacuolation/encephalopathy/NfL+GFAP toxicity wall.
discriminating_next_test: Empirically calibrate PI(3,5)P2 regeneration and ClC-7 vacuole-clearance half-lives upon washout over a strict 14-day kill-gate in C9orf72 and sALS iPSC-MNs to validate the hypothesized q48h-q72h single-pulse nanomolar PIKfyve window (6.5-8.0 nM unbound Cmax vs continuous BID), co-measuring paired intracellular vs conditioned-media secreted poly(GP)/pTDP-43 mass-balance (PMID:27732842; ruling out blocked unconventional exosomal secretion with intracellular DPR retention), microfluidic fast axonal transport kymography, and a prospective predictive biomarker for 16/16 Baricitinib/Apilimod non-cross-resistance: advance ONLY if pulsed dosing achieves >50% net intracellular poly(GP)/TDP-43 degradation with <5% end-of-cycle ClC-7 vacuolation (PMID:42900584), intact axonal transport, and zero NfL/GFAP surge.

name: Icerguastat (IFB-088 / Sephin1)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Modest survival gain at 2.5 uM in Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MNs (+1.618d, 13/16 lines, p=0.00202, q=0.0173); Zeng 2025 PPP1R15A dPAS=+0.0558 (padj=6.42e-8).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: ExploreALS cited corrupt IDs (CHEMBL3545058=Dextrothyroxine, CID:5702546=Resiniferatoxin; true Sephin1=CHEMBL2365743/CID:9561611, MW 196.64); direct PPP1R15A inhibition refuted (PMID:28447936; acts via 1-5 uM GluN2B/PHB2); in Phase 2 NCT05508074 (N=51), extreme first-pass clearance (CL/F=580 L/h in ALS; 736-1,388 L/h in Ph1 = 6.4-15.4x hepatic blood flow) capped GeoMean plasma Cmax at 12 ng/mL (GeoCV 66.4%, 61.0 nM, Cu,brain~13.0 nM = 193x below 2.5 uM) with flat ISR biomarker GDF15 (704.3->711.3->704.9 ng/mL), null ITT ALSFRS-R (-0.33, p=0.923), AND 2/34 (5.9% vs 0% pbo) drug-related fatal TEAEs, 3/34 (8.8%) Grade>=3 drug TEAEs/discontinuations, cardiac/cardiorespiratory arrest, and 8/34 (23.5% vs 0%) falls.
factual_justification: Falsified by a non-closable human PK/safety wall: extreme first-pass clearance (6.4-15.4x hepatic blood flow) caps Cu,brain at ~13.0 nM (193x below 2.5 uM active concentration, with flat human ISR GDF15 and null ITT ALSFRS-R p=0.923), while 25 mg BID already produced 2/34 (5.9% vs 0%) investigator-attributed drug-related fatal TEAEs and 23.5% falls, making 80-200x dose escalation toxicologically impossible.

name: AGAP2
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Unadjusted D003 BA9 L2_L3 log2FC=-0.805 (p=1.41e-7) and modest Bye 2025 RNA-seq log2FC=-0.231.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: High-GC (57.69%, r_GC=+0.810) drives BA9 signal; GC-adj p=0.00117 fails Holm (4.12e-7), M1 GC-adj p=0.054, Edinburgh EN_L2_L3 null (-0.031, p=0.891), Spillman homogenate opposite (+0.285, p=0.243), LOEUF=0.388, 0 ALS genetics.
factual_justification: Named BA9 excitatory call collapses under donor GC shift (p=0.00117), fails replication in Edinburgh BA44/BA46 (p=0.891) and M1 (p=0.054), trends opposite in cortical homogenate proteomics (+0.285), and lacks human ALS genetics (LOEUF=0.388).

name: AP1G2
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Unadjusted D003 BA9 L2_L3 log2FC=-1.187 (p=2.04e-9) and NYGC Frontal log2FC=-0.524.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: BA9 GC-adj p=8.52e-7 misses Holm (4.12e-7; r_GC=+0.547, GC=54.43%); flips sign in Edinburgh EN_L2_L3 (+0.282, p=0.376); null in NYGC Motor RIN+GC (p=0.196) & Cervical SC (p=0.279); undetected in proteomics; 0 ALS genetics.
factual_justification: Loses BA9 family-wise significance after donor GC control (p=8.52e-7), reverses sign in Edinburgh BA44/BA46 (+0.282, p=0.376), is null in motor/spinal bulk RNA-seq, undetected across cortical/CSF proteomics, and has zero ALS genetics.

name: BRSK2
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Unadjusted D003 BA9 L2_L3/L3_L5/L4_L5 log2FC=-0.584 to -0.714.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Extreme GC (63.85%, 97.5th pct; r_GC=+0.806) drives all 3 BA9 tests out of Holm & 1.5x SEOI (GC-adj p=9.88e-6..3.87e-5); null in M1 L4_L5 (p=0.991), Edinburgh (+0.041, p=0.825), NYGC Motor RIN+GC (p=0.372), and Spillman homogenate (+0.198, p=0.434); LOEUF=0.335 autism gene, 0 ALS genetics.
factual_justification: Archetypal high-GC (63.85%) postmortem cortical artifact failing Holm across all 3 BA9 clusters upon GC adjustment, completely null in Edinburgh snRNA-seq (p=0.825..0.997), M1, and Spillman proteomics (+0.198, p=0.434), with severe LoF constraint (LOEUF=0.335).

name: DNAJB2
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Sole BA9 gene surviving GC-adjusted Holm in Oligo (-0.745, p=3.46e-7), replicating in M1 Oligo (-0.618, p=2.59e-4), NYGC Cervical SC (-0.293, p=5.21e-5), Spillman synaptosomes (-0.511, p=0.0132) & iPSC neurons (-1.115, p=0.0455), backed by 55 ClinVar P/LP variants causing human DSMA5/CMT2T/juvenile ALS.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Edinburgh OD is noisy/non-significant (-0.397, p=0.447), NYGC Motor bulk flips slightly (+0.087, p=0.401), CSF TMT is null (p=0.779), cellular compartment dominance (oligodendrocyte vs motor neuron) is unresolved, 1,151-bp Intron 9 (chr2:219284836-219285986(+)) lacks mapped ISS vs ISE cis-elements (where masking an ISE would worsen Intron-9 retention), and zero-sum splice-conversion of shared pre-mRNA DNAJB2b->DNAJB2a risks depleting ER-prenylated DNAJB2b required for neuronal ERAD.
factual_justification: Unlike high-GC excitatory BA9 artifacts, DNAJB2 (HSJ1) survives BA9 GC-adjusted Holm, shows concordant M1 oligo, cervical spinal, synaptosomal, and iPSC neuronal loss, and causes human recessive motor neuropathy/juvenile ALS; cell-compartment (oligodendrocyte vs motor neuron) dominance, Intron-9 ISS-vs-ISE cis-regulatory polarity, and ERAD-sparing cytosolic DNAJB2a augmentation remain untested in sALS.
discriminating_next_test: Isoform- and compartment-resolved test quantifying sALS spinal/oligodendrocyte DNAJB2a vs DNAJB2b precursor pools by PRM and comparing exogenous cytosolic DNAJB2a replacement (ENST00000392086.8, 277 aa: splices Exon 9 chr2:219284632-219284835(+) across Intron 9 chr2:219284836-219285986(+) into Exon 10 chr2:219285987-219286898(+); Brain 2016 PMID:26936937; stop-loss neuromyopathy PMID:37070754) against a tiled 1,151-bp Intron-9 SSO micro-walk (testing whether functional ISS silencers exist without hitting wrong-sign ISE enhancers, 3'SS traps, or RNase-H gapmers), gated on BiP/HSPA5 + CHOP/DDIT3 ERAD counter-screens to prevent zero-sum depletion of ER-prenylated DNAJB2b (ENST00000336576.10, 324 aa) across sALS iPSC motor-neuron and oligodendrocyte co-cultures.

name: KIFC2
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Unadjusted D003 BA9 L5/L4_L6/L4_L5/L3_L5 log2FC=-0.942 to -1.007.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Extreme GC (63.73%, 97.4th pct; r_GC=+0.751..+0.826) knocks all 4 BA9 clusters above Holm (GC-adj p=1.80e-5..7.62e-5); flips sign in Edinburgh EN_L5_L6 (+0.433, p=0.429); null in NYGC Motor RIN+GC (p=0.332); undetected in homogenate/iPSC MS; 0 ALS genetics.
factual_justification: Extreme-GC (63.73%) transcript losing family-wise significance across all 4 BA9 clusters after donor GC control, flipping sign in Edinburgh EN_L5_L6 (+0.433, p=0.429), null in RIN+GC-adjusted motor bulk, and devoid of human ALS genetics.

name: MIB2
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Unadjusted D003 BA9 L2_L3 log2FC=-0.852 (p=1.67e-7).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Highest GC of all 10 BA9 genes (66.41%, 99.0th pct; r_GC=+0.809); GC-adj p=0.00136 fails Holm & SEOI; null in M1 GC-adj (p=0.155), Edinburgh (+0.053, p=0.847), NYGC Motor RIN+GC (p=0.185), and Spillman homogenate (+0.052, p=0.871); 0 ALS genetics.
factual_justification: Highest-GC gene in the BA9 cohort (66.41%) whose BA9 signal collapses under donor GC adjustment (p=0.00136) and is completely null across M1 (p=0.155), Edinburgh snRNA-seq (+0.053, p=0.847), Spillman cortical homogenate (+0.052, p=0.871), and ALS genetics.

name: MYO18A
evidence_proves_hypothesis: D003 BA9 Oligo unadjusted log2FC=+0.624 (p=6.38e-7).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Fails Holm after GC (p=6.86e-5; r_GC=-0.597), null in M1 Oligo GC-adj (+0.105, p=0.321), reverses sign in Edinburgh OD (-0.391, p=0.452) and all 3 NYGC bulk regions (Frontal -0.239, Motor -0.385, Cervical SC -0.400, p=1.55e-5), null in Spillman MS (+0.228, p=0.352), LOEUF=0.399, 0 human ALS genetics.
factual_justification: BA9 oligodendrocyte elevation (+0.624) fails Holm after GC control, is null in M1 oligos (p=0.321) and Spillman proteomics (p=0.352..0.693), significantly reverses sign across NYGC Frontal, Motor, and Cervical SC (-0.400, p=1.55e-5), and is LoF-intolerant (LOEUF=0.399).

name: SNPH
evidence_proves_hypothesis: M1 L2_L3 shows GC-independent RNA reduction (-1.529, p=3.61e-4, r_GC=+0.020; NYGC Motor comp+GC -0.381, p=2.28e-5), Spillman DIA shows homogenate (+0.710, p=0.00536) & iPSC (+0.171, p=0.0396) accumulation, and 2025 human neuromuscular assembloids (PMID:41193975) show SNPH loss boosts mitochondrial transport & NMJ formation.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: High fragility: gnomAD pLI=0.996 (LOEUF=0.461), 0 ALS genetics, null SOD1-G93A mouse Snph KO (Zhu & Sheng 2011), BA9 RNA failed Holm (p=1.64e-4; Edinburgh p=0.732), and opposite-sign synaptosome (-0.260, p=0.320) vs homogenate (+0.710) may reflect passive proximal axonal spheroid trapping.
factual_justification: Although BA9 RNA was GC-confounded and fragility is high (gnomAD pLI=0.996, LOEUF=0.461; null SOD1-G93A KO in Zhu & Sheng 2011; opposite synaptosome -0.260 vs homogenate +0.710 potentially reflecting proximal axonal spheroid trapping), GC-free M1 reduction and 2025 human assembloid NMJ rescue leave graded sALS knockdown untested.
discriminating_next_test: Graded 30-50% SNPH knockdown targeting shared coding exon chr20:1304877-1309327(+) (ENST00000381867.6, sparing pLI=0.996 full KO) in TDP-43-stressed human sALS neuromuscular assembloids (extending WT assembloid PMID:41193975 against null SOD1-G93A Snph KO PMID:21518771), gating on proximal SNPH/NEFH/BSN/APP insoluble spheroid relief, axonal bioenergetics/ROS, and Ca2+ buffering.

name: ZNF783
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Unadjusted D003 BA9 L2_L3 log2FC=-0.723 (p=1.02e-8).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: BA9 r_GC=+0.715 knocks GC-adj p to 5.53e-5 (fails Holm); M1 L2_L3 GC-adj collapses to -0.082 (p=0.510); Edinburgh EN_L2_L3 reverses sign (+0.292, GC-adj p=0.0471); NYGC Motor RIN+GC null (p=0.175); 0 peptides in proteomics; 0 ALS genetics or ligandability.
factual_justification: Uncharacterized KRAB-ZNF whose BA9 signal fails Holm after GC adjustment (p=5.53e-5), collapses in M1 (p=0.510), significantly reverses sign in Edinburgh BA44/BA46 (+0.292, p=0.047), is undetected across all proteomics, and lacks ALS genetics.

name: CAPG
evidence_proves_hypothesis: NYGC Cervical SC bulk log2FC=+1.414 (p=3.45e-15), Spillman cortex homogenate +0.956 (p=2.92e-4), and Trautwig CSF DIA +0.252 (p=0.0105).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Purified single-nucleus microglia trend negative across D003 BA9 (-0.849, p=0.111), D003 M1 (-0.818, p=0.090), and Edinburgh MIG (-0.484, p=0.476); NYGC Frontal trends negative (-0.216, p=0.0695); CSF TMT is null (+0.056, p=0.194); 0 ALS genetics and OpenTargets grade 3-4 neurotoxicity flag.
factual_justification: Bulk spinal/homogenate CAPG elevation is a pure microglial cell-fraction expansion artifact: per-cell microglial snRNA-seq expression trends negative across all 3 cortical cohorts, CSF TMT is non-significant (p=0.194), ALS genetics are absent, and OpenTargets flags grade 3-4 neurotoxicity.

name: Dexmedetomidine
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.3992d across 16 sALS lines (12/16 >0d, t=3.250, p=0.00538, q=0.03030, Rank #7/107).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: IV ICU sedative (0.2-0.7 ug/kg/h) achieves <=0.318 nM unbound CNS exposure where ADRA2A agonism (Ki~1.65 nM) already causes deep sedation, hypotension, and sinus bradycardia — a 7,862x exposure deficit vs 2,500 nM screen (ADRA2A/B/C non-DE in Bye RNA-seq).
factual_justification: Despite genuine 2.5 uM iPSC-MN rescue (+1.399d, q=0.0303), tolerated human unbound CNS exposure (~0.32 nM IV ICU infusion) is 7,862-fold below the screen concentration and capped by dose-limiting sedation, hypotension, and bradycardia.

name: CuATSM
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.3792d across 15 valid sALS lines (12/15 >0d, p=0.00631, q=0.03375, Rank #8/107; true ID CHEMBL4297372, fixing intake CHEMBL4297643 typo).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Phase 2/3 placebo-controlled ALS trial NCT04082832 (72 mg/d oral, N=80) completed late 2021 with randomized clinical efficacy withheld/unreported (CT.gov hasResults=false; OLE NCT04313166 terminated and sponsor discontinued ALS development), postmortem neuropathology of treated trial decedents (Yang 2023 PMID:37317638, n=6 vs 6) showed no reduction in pTDP-43 burden or motor neuron loss, 62Cu/64Cu-ATSM PET reflects hypoxic Cu(I) dissociation rather than verified intact 2.5 uM normoxic CNS exposure (~47x nominal gap at 72 mg/d MTD bounded by 144 mg/d Phase 1 transaminitis, PMID:22036688), and sporadic TDP-43 ALS lacks human genetic support for SOD1 copper-delivery rescue.
factual_justification: Under Epistemic Asymmetry, withheld/unreported randomized Phase 2/3 efficacy outcomes in NCT04082832 (hasResults=false) plus a small observational autopsy series (Yang 2023 PMID:37317638, n=6 vs 6 showing unaltered pTDP-43 and MN loss) do not constitute published powered RCT clinical futility; S02 (CHEMBL4297372) is retained on the low-priority Tier 3 watchlist behind 5 unsolved clinical, neuropathological, PK (~47x screen gap), and mechanistic hurdles.
discriminating_next_test: Require public release and independent statistical audit of unblinded Phase 2/3 NCT04082832 ALSFRS-R/ECAS outcomes alongside 10-100 nM vs 2.5 uM intact unbound CuATSM concentration-response and radical-trapping ferroptosis target-engagement deconvolution in TDP-43-depleted human sALS iPSC-MNs before any renewed clinical consideration.

name: Mycophenolate mofetil
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.2792d across 15 valid sALS lines (12/15 >0d, p=0.00293, q=0.02090, Rank #10/107; true IDs CHEMBL1456/CHEMBL866, fixing intake CHEMBL1230607 typo).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Active MPA is 98% albumin-bound (fu=0.02) and actively effluxed at BBB (Kpuu~0.08), yielding Cu_CNS ~20 nM at 1000 mg BID (125x below 2500 nM neuronal screen), carries FDA Boxed Warnings for PML/fatal infections/lymphoma, and had 0/31 responders with 42% AE dropouts in ALS Phase 2 NCT01884571.
factual_justification: Active MPA suffers a 125-fold human unbound CNS deficit (~20 nM vs 2,500 nM screen) due to 98% albumin binding and BBB organic-anion efflux, carries FDA Boxed Warnings for PML and fatal infections, and failed human ALS Phase 2 trial NCT01884571 (0/31 responders, 42% AE dropouts).

name: Tamoxifen
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.2742d across 16 sALS lines (13/16 >0d, p=0.00316, q=0.02104, Rank #11/107).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: At 20-40 mg/d PO, fu=0.008 yields Cu_brain ~2.59 nM (965x below 2,500 nM screen & >1,000x below PKC IC50 ~3 uM); cationic amphiphile (ALogP=6.00) induces in vitro phospholipidosis at 2.5 uM, carries FDA Boxed Warnings for fatal stroke/PE/uterine sarcoma, and showed no durable 12-mo ALSFRS-R benefit across NCT01257581 (N=60), NCT00214110 (N=100), and Chen 2020.
factual_justification: Unbound human brain tamoxifen (~2.59 nM at 40 mg/d, fu=0.008) is 965-fold below the 2.5 uM screen concentration (a canonical ALogP=6.0 cationic amphiphilic phospholipidosis/PKC regime), carries Boxed Warnings for fatal stroke/PE, and failed to show durable efficacy across 3 human ALS trials.

name: Lonafarnib / Tipifarnib (FTIs)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Lonafarnib (CHEMBL298734, FTase IC50=1.9 nM) and Tipifarnib (CHEMBL289228, FTase IC50=0.57-0.90 nM) potently inhibit protein farnesyltransferase in biochemical assays and reduce mutant progerin/Rhes farnesylation in non-ALS models.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Falsified on three independent axes: (1) Directional paradox: GGTase-III (PTAR1/RABGGTB, PDB 6J74) strictly requires prior FTase Cys195 farnesylation to geranylgeranylate YKT6 Cys194 (pan-essential DepMap Chronos=-1.5425), so FTIs block YKT6 maturation and worsen the exact TDP-43-driven YKT6 APA (padj=4.57e-40) + PTAR1 frameshifting exon-skipping (dPSI=+0.1563, FDR=3.26e-6) defect in sALS MNs; (2) Unbound CNS PK deficit: Lonafarnib (MW 638.83 Da, PPB>=99%, marginal P-gp substrate) achieves Cmax,u<=42.2 nM at 150 mg/m2 BID and estimated Cu,brain<=2.1-8.4 nM (Tipifarnib Cu,brain<=2.0-12.8 nM) vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50 (8x->100x gap); (3) Human toxicity: ZOKINVY causes 90% vomiting, 81% diarrhea, 37% weight loss (lethal risk factor in ALS), 35% myelosuppression, +19ms QTc prolongation, and severe CYP3A autoinhibition/DDIs.
factual_justification: Dropped due to human unbound CNS exposure deficit (Cu,brain <=2-13 nM vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50), ALS-hostile human clinical toxicities (37% weight loss, 81-90% GI toxicity, 35% myelosuppression, +19ms QTc), and direct mechanistic antagonism of essential YKT6 Cys195/Cys194 dual prenylation in TDP-43-compromised motor neurons.

name: SARM1 (Axonal NADase)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rare constitutively active ARM-domain GoF variants enrich in human ALS (Gilley 2021; Bloom 2022; OT genetic_score=0.195), executing Wallerian NAD+ catastrophe; elevated protein in small-sample C9FTD iPSC neurons (+0.675, p=0.0268, n=3 vs 3); no population depletion of heterozygous pLoF variants in gnomAD v4 (obs/exp=60/65.1, LOEUF=1.143; distinct from biallelic KO phenotyping).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Postmortem end-stage bulk RNA is lower (-0.307) due to projection-neuron dropout, clinical SARM1 space has moderate crowding across Disarm-lineage orthosteric base-exchange prodrug Lilly LY3873862 (NCT07883590 [Ph1 Not Yet Recruiting], PMID:33406435) and oral reversible orthosteric inhibitor Nura/TRICALS NB-4746 (NCT07369076, undisclosed clinical structure) plus preclinical ASHA-624, 2026 Commun Chem (PMID:42156967, PDB 9TZY) warns orthosteric base-exchange scaffolds risk paradoxical sub-inhibitory SARM1 activation (0.05x-0.30x Kd), covalent Cys311 isothiazole/dHNN electrophiles (PDB 7DJT, PMID:33944777) carry chronic proteome-wide CNS thiol reactivity liabilities, and mouse Cd38-/- and axonal studies indicate bulk tissue/fluid cADPR is predominantly generated by ecto-CD38 (PMID:32087251; PMID:16750163) rather than intra-axonal motor-neuron SARM1.
factual_justification: Core Track B target backed by human ALS rare GoF genetics, parallel axonal protection alongside STMN2 (Krus et al. 2022 PMID:35767949), elevated patient iPSC neuronal protein (+0.675, p=0.0268, n=6), and low heterozygous pLoF constraint (LOEUF=1.143); despite clinical activity (LY3873862 NCT07883590 [Not Yet Recruiting], NB-4746 NCT07369076), CNS-penetrant non-covalent intramolecular ARM-TIR T-lock glues (ASHA-624 class; covalent Cys311 PDB 7DJT as structural benchmark) avoid biphasic base-exchange activation.
discriminating_next_test: Prioritize CNS-penetrant non-covalent intramolecular ARM-TIR T-lock glues (ASHA-624 class; using covalent Cys311 PDB 7DJT strictly as structural octamer benchmark rather than chronic oral NCE) head-to-head against Disarm-lineage 3-chain TIR-gluing base-exchange inhibitor (BEXi) prodrugs (PDB 9TZY, LY3873862, PMID:33406435, PMID:42156967) and empirically decoupled reversible orthosteric NB-4746 (NCT07369076, undisclosed structure) across full trough-to-peak and 48-72 h simulated oral CNS washout curves (5x -> 0.03x IC50, modeling missed doses in bulbar dysphagia) in microfluidic WT and isogenic SARM1 p.L223P ARM-GoF negative-control human sALS motor axons +/- STMN2 splice rescue (evaluating Bliss/Loewe additivity vs illustrative ~2-7x MWC sensitivity scenario), anchoring human Phase 1b PD on unbound CSF Ctrough,u >= IC80 (Kp,uu >= 0.30), zero washout CSF pNfH/plasma NfL spike, and exploratory L1CAM/ATP1A3+ neuron-derived EV cADPR:NAD+ (given mouse Cd38-/- evidence of non-neuronal CD38 background in bulk cADPR, PMID:32087251/PMID:16750163) while reserving SARM1 KD ASO (PMID:40473123) for <1% ARM-broken GoF carriers.

name: Low-Dose Aldesleukin (IL-2) in Low-pNfH Stratum
evidence_proves_hypothesis: In MIROCALS Phase 2b (NCT03039673, PMID:40354799, Lancet May 2025, N=220; CHEMBL1201438), SAP-prespecified covariate-adjusted Cox + continuous log(BioVendor ELISA CSF pNfH)xTreatment modeling was positive (adj HR=0.32, 95% CI 0.14-0.73, p=0.007), with 48% 21-mo mortality hazard reduction in the 750-3,700 pg/mL stratum (n=154, HR=0.52, 95% CI 0.30-0.89, p=0.016; <750 pg/mL LLOQ n=20 had 0 deaths) alongside FOXP3+ Treg expansion and CCL2 reduction.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Primary unadjusted ITT log-rank test missed significance (HR=0.81, 95% CI 0.54-1.22, p=0.33; >3,700 pg/mL n=46 non-significant futility HR=1.37, 95% CI 0.68-2.75, p=0.38), IL2/IL2RA has 0 human ALS genetics, EMA/MHRA/UK MND CSG declined approval pending Phase 3 proof, ALS FOXP3+ Tregs risk TSDR methylation drift + NK/eosinophil/sCD25 sinks, and zero prospective Phase 3 trials gated on calibrated CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL have completed.
factual_justification: Under Epistemic Asymmetry, covariate-adjusted survival benefit (HR=0.32, p=0.007) and 750-3,700 pg/mL BioVendor ELISA stratum benefit (HR=0.52, p=0.016, n=154) inside an unadjusted-ITT-null Phase 2b trial (MIROCALS PMID:40354799, HR=0.81, p=0.33) with zero IL2/IL2RA ALS genetics require prospective biomarker-gated Phase 3 confirmation.
discriminating_next_test: Complete Stage-0 paired analytical bridging from MIROCALS BioVendor ELISA CSF pNfH to automated CLIA immunoassays (Ella/Euroimmun/Simoa) plus paired NfL vs pNfH immunoassay calibration on banked ALS CSF (motivated by weak tryptic MS NEFL vs NEFH correlation r=0.278 in Trautwig 2025 PMC12082929 across n=77 DIA / n=51 overlapping Emory TMT; note active ALSTARS NCT07161999 lacks a CSF pNfH gate), then execute an event-driven Phase 3 RCT powered for 247 deaths at conservative HR=0.70 (138 at HR=0.62; requiring N~650-750 over 36-42 mo variable follow-up or N~850-1,050 at 24 mo, <5% vital-status censoring) enrolling calibrated CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL with longitudinal Treg TSDR (PMID:17694575), CD56bright NK, and sCD25 (PMID:22343569) monitoring.

name: Ultrahigh-Dose Methylcobalamin (Rozebalamin)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Phase 3 JETALS RCT (NCT03548311, Oki et al. JAMA Neurol 2022, PMID:35532908, N=130 <=1yr onset; true ID CHEMBL4297672, fixing intake Dacomitinib typo) slowed 16-wk ALSFRS-R decline by 43% (+1.97 pts, p=0.01; +2.11 w/ riluzole) and lowered homocysteine, achieving Japan PMDA approval (Rozebalamin 50 mg IM, Sept 2024).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Efficacy is restricted to early <=12-month onset (prior <3yr trial NCT00444613 N=373 missed ITT), and unshielded 2.5 uM methylcobalamin scored -3.60d (q=0.00246, Rank #105/107) in Bye 2025, plausibly explained by blue-light live-imaging Co-C bond photolysis (hypothesis requiring dark-shielded vs lit control verification).
factual_justification: Clinically proven and PMDA-approved (Sept 2024) standard-of-care benchmark in early-onset (<=12m) ALS (+1.97 ALSFRS-R pts in Phase 3 JETALS, p=0.01); also highlights plausible Co-C photolability false-negative risk in unshielded live-imaging iPSC screens.

name: Censavudine (TPN-101) in ALS-TE Subtype
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Phase 2a NCT04993755 (N=42 C9orf72-ALS/FTD, 400 mg/d PO TPN-101 / CHEMBL124363) showed favorable safety, reduced CSF IL-6 & NfL, and ~50% slower 24-wk vital capacity decline (-8.4% vs -16.5% placebo in C9-ALS); within motor ALS cortex, ALS-TE elevates IFNAR2 both vs ALS-Ox (+0.2793, p=6.32e-8, GC+cellcomp adj_p=3.87e-9, AUC=0.7698) and vs Control (+0.1920, p=6.62e-4, adj_p=0.0376) while retaining intact TYK2 (+0.5763 vs Ox, p=5.52e-9, AUC=0.8382) and STAT2 (+0.3103 vs Ox, p=5.14e-8, AUC=0.7780).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Primary re-analysis of O'Neill 2025 (DS001_ONEILL) shows cortical ALS-TE dropped to 13.40% (41/306 donors; 11.52% in non-C9 sALS), spinal cord ALS-TE is 0.00% (0/331 donors, 100% masked by ventral-horn gliosis/ox), and postmortem cortical ALS-TE TYK2 (-0.0732, p=0.465) & STAT2 (+0.0153, p=0.798) plus bulk ISGs (ISG15/IFIT1/MX1/OAS1/IRF9) are flat vs Control (as ALS-Ox depletes TYK2 -0.650, p=2.05e-12), with zero sporadic ALS-TE patients ever tested, no peer-reviewed NCT04993755 manuscript yet, and no validated living-CSF ALS-TE diagnostic.
factual_justification: Oral LINE-1 RT inhibitor TPN-101 demonstrated encouraging Phase 2a biomarker (CSF IL-6/NfL) and vital-capacity signals in C9orf72-ALS, and cortical ALS-TE elevates IFNAR2 above Control while preserving TYK2/STAT2 relative to ALS-Ox, but extension to sporadic ALS-TE (and whether active cGAS-STING/Type I IFN signaling operates in living patients despite end-stage postmortem ISG quiescence) is untested and gated by lower cortical prevalence (13.53% motor-ALS; 11.52% non-C9 sALS), ventral-horn glial masking (0/331 bulk cord), and biomarker role disaggregation.
discriminating_next_test: Disaggregate the living-biofluid gate by biological role prior to sporadic TPN-101 trials: (1) cryptic HDGFL2 (PMID:38278991/PMID:42854693) solely as the upstream pan-TDP-43 pathology gate (excluding SOD1/FUS, not separating ALS-TE from ALS-Ox/ALS-Glia), (2) direct retroelement cargo (LINE-1 ORF1p Simoa PMID:40050409 + CSF EV L1HS RNA/cDNA) as the subtype-specific ALS-TE enrichment gate calibrated to 13.53% (41/303 non-discordant; 11.52% non-C9 sALS) cortical prevalence (0/331 bulk cord), and (3) ultrasensitive CSF IL-6 strictly as a longitudinal within-patient PD readout (confounded at baseline by respiratory hypoxia/microgliosis), requiring elevated living cGAS-STING/pSTAT2/ISG activity in ORF1p+/L1HS+ vs ORF1p- ALS-Ox patients before any exploratory CNS TYK2-JH2 (BHV-8000 class) test.
